newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Morgan, Lehman Q1 EPS views raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Morgan, Lehman Q1 EPS views raised.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Raphael Soifer said he raised his fiscal first quarter earnings estimates on Lehman Bros Holdings Inc and Morgan Stanley Group Inc.
-- Raised Morgan Stanley estimate to $1.55 from $1.40.
-- Cited strong conditions in financial markets, relatively strong merger and acquisition activity and brisk bond underwriting.
-- Left full year estimates unchanged at $3.75 for Lehman and $5.50 for Morgan Stanley and kept both shares rated market perform/hold.
-- Noted "expenses will remain something of a wild card" at Morgan Stanley due to pending merger with Dean Witter Discover & Co.
